description:
Bring the scientific literature into ChatGPT:

- Searches comprehensively for relevant papers
- Reads and understands full texts, figures, and tables
- Retrieves open-access PDFs automatically
- Makes your uploaded PDFs available in every chat
- Organizes your papers and stores your insights

Used by scientists at thousands of institutions, from university labs to pharma R&D teams.

defaultPrompt: Find and read the 4 best studies on melatonin and sleep
Find all studies published on creatine and memory in humans
